using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.common.tests;

public class FormatTests
{
    private static readonly List<(LogLevel Level, string Message, object[] Args)> _logs = new();

    private static readonly ILogger Logger = NullLogger.Instance; // Will be replaced by mock

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_NoIpAddressesFound_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new MockLogger();
        var hostname = "nonexistent.invalid"; // Hostname that returns no IPs

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 6379, logger: mockLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        Assert.Single(mockLogger.Logs);
        var log = mockLogger.Logs[0];
        Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Error, log.Level);
        Assert.Equal("No IP address found for hostname:{hostname}", log.Message);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { hostname }, log.Args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_HostnameMismatch_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new MockLogger();
        var hostname = "otherhost";
        var fakeMachineName = "myhost";

        // Act - hostname won't match fakeMachineName, will log error
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 6379, tryConnect: false, logger: mockLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        Assert.Single(mockLogger.Logs);
        var log = mockLogger.Logs[0];
        Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Error, log.Level);
        Assert.Equal("Provided hostname does not much acquired machine name {addressOrHostname} {machineHostname}!", log.Message);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { hostname, fakeMachineName }, log.Args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_NoReachableIpWithTryConnect_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new MockLogger();
        var hostname = "localhost"; // Will resolve but tryConnect fails

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 9999, tryConnect: true, logger: mockLogger);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        Assert.Contains(mockLogger.Logs, log => 
            log.Level == LogLevel.Error && 
            log.Message == "No reachable IP address found for hostname:{hostname}" &&
            log.Args.SequenceEqual(new[] { hostname }));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_DnsException_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new MockLogger();
        var invalidHostname = new string('x', 300); // Too long, likely throws

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.ThrowsAny<Exception>(() => Format.TryCreateEndpoint(invalidHostname, 6379, logger: mockLogger));
        Assert.Contains(mockLogger.Logs, log => 
            log.Level == LogLevel.Error && 
            log.Message.StartsWith("Error while trying to resolve hostname:"));
    }
}

public class MockLogger : ILogger
{
    public List<(LogLevel Level, string Message, object[] Args)> Logs { get; } = new();

    public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null!;

    public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

    public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception? exception, Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
    {
        var message = formatter(state, exception);
        var args = state as IEnumerable<object> ?? Array.Empty<object>();
        Logs.Add((logLevel, message, args.ToArray()));
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.common.tests;

public class FormatTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_NoIpAddressesFound_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var hostname = "nonexistent.invalid";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 6379, logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(
            LogLevel.Error,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("No IP address found for hostname:") && v.ToString()!.Contains(hostname)),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_HostnameMismatch_LogsError()
    {
        // Arrange - Need to mock Dns.GetHostAddresses and Environment.MachineName
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var hostname = "otherhost";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(hostname, 6379, tryConnect: false, logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Null(result);
        mockLogger.Verify(x => x.Log(
            LogLevel.Error,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Provided hostname does not much acquired machine name") && v.ToString()!.Contains(hostname)),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIP_ReturnsEndpoint()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var ipString = "127.0.0.1";

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(ipString, 6379, logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(result);
        Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(result[0]);
        var endpoint = (IPEndPoint)result[0];
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Loopback, endpoint.Address);
        Assert.Equal(6379, endpoint.Port);
        mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_ReturnsLoopbackEndpoints()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", 6379, logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => ((IPEndPoint)ep).Address.Equals(IPAddress.Loopback));
        mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_EmptyString_ReturnsBindAnyEndpoints()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("", 6379, logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => ((IPEndPoint)ep).Address.Equals(IPAddress.Any));
        mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.common.tests;

public class FormatTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_ValidIP_ReturnsSingleEndpoint()
    {
        // Arrange
        var ipString = "127.0.0.1";
        var port = 6379;

        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint(ipString, port);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.Single(result);
        Assert.IsType<IPEndPoint>(result[0]);
        var endpoint = (IPEndPoint)result[0];
        Assert.Equal(IPAddress.Parse(ipString), endpoint.Address);
        Assert.Equal(port, endpoint.Port);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_Localhost_ReturnsLoopbackEndpoints()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("localhost", 6379);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => 
        {
            if (ep is IPEndPoint ipe) 
                return ipe.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Loopback) || ipe.Address.Equals(IPAddress.IPv6Loopback);
            return false;
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryCreateEndpoint_EmptyString_ReturnsBindAnyEndpoints()
    {
        // Act
        var result = Format.TryCreateEndpoint("", 6379);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
        Assert.Contains(result, ep => 
        {
            if (ep is IPEndPoint ipe) 
                return ipe.Address.Equals(IPAddress.Any) || ipe.Address.Equals(IPAddress.IPv6Any);
            return false;
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_ValidAddressList_ReturnsEndpoints()
    {
        // Arrange
        var addressList = "127.0.0.1 127.0.0.2";
        var port = 6379;

        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList(addressList, port, out var endpoints, out var error);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(success);
        Assert.Null(error);
        Assert.NotNull(endpoints);
        Assert.Equal(2, endpoints.Length);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryParseAddressList_EmptyList_ProtectedMode_ReturnsLoopback()
    {
        // Arrange
        var port = 6379;

        // Act
        var success = Format.TryParseAddressList("", port, out var endpoints, out var error, protectedMode: true);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(success);
        Assert.Null(error);
        Assert.NotNull(endpoints);
        Assert.Contains(endpoints, ep => ((IPEndPoint)ep).Address.Equals(IPAddress.Loopback));
    }
}

            Assert.True(result.Length >= 1);
